gamma φ (y / x) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (-y / x ^ 2) * (1 / x) - gamma φ (y / x * ((1 - x) / (1 - y))) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (-y / (x ^ 2 * (1 - y))) * ((1 - x) / (x * (1 - y) ^ 2)) + gamma φ ((1 - x) / (1 - y)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (-1 / (1 - y)) * ((1 - x) / (1 - y) ^ 2) = 0
